Get ready to experience passion, drama, action and romance like never before with the exciting world of Dizi! With our Dizi app you can watch hundreds of hours of high-budget Turkish drama series from major Turkish producers and featuring popular Turkish stars, such as International Emmy Award nominees Engin Akyürek and Tuba Büyüküstün, Kıvanç Tatlıtuğ, Bergüzar Korel, Kenan İmirzalıoğlu, and Farah Zeynep Abdullah.

What you'll love about the Dizi Channel App:

*** Hundreds of hours of critically acclaimed and popular dizis available for your viewing pleasure, all in one place!

*** Stream your favorite Turkish series 7/24 from multiple devices, anytime & anywhere you want.

*** Episodes dubbed or subtitled in multiple languages, so you can enjoy your favorite Turkish series wherever you're from!

***Don't have access to the internet? No worries! Download each episode to your mobile device and watch offline whenever you want - while you travel, commute, or while you're on break, sipping your favorite Turkish coffee."
